roles.label: Merchant operator
roles.description: Standard tenant membership for day-to-day operational work.

roles.label: Moderator
roles.description: Bounded review responsibility for tenant evidence and support workflows.

roles.label: Administrator
roles.description: Tenant identity administration. This role does not imply financial or tax authority.

roles.label: Tax rule author
roles.description: Create and simulate governed tax-rule drafts.

roles.label: Tax rule reviewer
roles.description: Review governed tax-rule drafts before approval.

roles.label: Tax rule approver
roles.description: Approve governed tax-rule drafts for publication.

roles.label: Tax treatment author
roles.description: Create and simulate governed tax-treatment evidence.

roles.label: Tax treatment reviewer
roles.description: Review governed tax-treatment evidence before approval.

roles.label: Tax treatment approver
roles.description: Approve governed tax-treatment evidence for publication.

roles.label: Treasury release proposer
roles.description: Prepare a bounded treasury release for separate approval.

roles.label: Partner payout proposer
roles.description: Propose a governed partner payout plan.

roles.label: Partner payout approver
roles.description: Approve a governed partner payout plan.

roles.label: Partner payout operator
roles.description: Prepare a release from an already governed partner payout plan.

roles.label: Partner payout governance
roles.description: Govern lifecycle transitions for partner payout plans.

roles.label: Partner payout auditor
roles.description: Review governed partner payout plans and balances.

roles.label: Adjustment proposer
roles.description: Prepare a correction or refund request for review.

roles.label: Adjustment governance
roles.description: Govern cancellation of refund requests and adjustment records.

roles.label: Adjustment approver
roles.description: Approve a refund payment after all checks pass.

roles.label: Indexer operator
roles.description: Investigate and recover bounded indexer exceptions.
